title: Tourist Season, 2012
logline: The motel full. A guest checks in at 1 AM with a dog, against policy. Wood looks at the dog, looks at the policy card, turns the card face down.

panels.composition: The desk, 1 AM. NO VACANCY lit outside. A GUEST with a suitcase and a small dog. The NO PETS card on the counter. WOOD. BARNABY under the desk, invisible to the guest.

balloons.text: I know it says. He's quiet. I've been driving since Reno.

image.prompt: a motel night desk at 1 AM with a tired guest holding a suitcase and a small dog, a NO PETS card on the counter, a clerk in a maroon polo, an old dog hidden beneath the desk, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel
image.notes: Letter after: NO PETS on the card, NO VACANCY in the window.

panels.composition: Wood looking at the small dog. The small dog looking at the desk, where something under it is breathing.

image.prompt: close-up of a small dog looking curiously at the front of a desk

panels.composition: Wood's hand turning the NO PETS card face down. That's all.

image.prompt: close-up of a hand turning a small printed card face down on a motel counter, no words

panels.composition: The guest gone up. Wood at the desk. Barnaby's head out from under it, looking at the stairs. The card face down all night.

image.prompt: a clerk at a motel desk at night with an old dog's head emerging from beneath it looking toward the stairs, a card face down on the counter, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The policy card turned face down. 'He's from Reno.'
